default/30957.htm.text: Bard Swan: "... your hair shines more brightly than the sun reflected from the sparkling silver waters of the river..." No. It's no good. Even I, the most respected bard in the kingdom cannot express your beauty in words! Hey! How long have you been standing there? Have you been eavesdropping on me?

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-01.htm.text: Bard Swan: I am uncomfortable talking about my feelings, but she is so beautiful and pure... She is the perfect woman! No... she is a goddess! If only I could tell her of my feelings... Her flute playing is sublime! She is renowned, even among the musicians of her own race, for her incredible talen…

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-03.html.text: Bard Swan: I am uncomfortable talking about my feelings, but she is so beautiful and pure... She is the perfect woman! No... she is a goddess! You are not worthy to even speak her name! (This quest may only be undertaken by a character of level 15 or above.)

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-04.html.text: Bard Swan: My goddess... Oh, my dear goddess... I pray the flute makes her happy... What are you still doing here? Go and see Trader Woodrow of the Town of Aden and find out whether the flute I ordered has arrived.

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-05.html.text: Bard Swan: Oh, thank you! The flute is beautiful! Surely this will please my beloved Nanarin . Would you perhaps be willing to take the flute to her, along with my letter? Please say that you will do this one last thing for me.

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-06.html.text: Bard Swan: Did you deliver the flute and letter to Nanarin? What did she say? Please tell me!

links.text: "She liked the flute but she doesn't like you."

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-01.html.text: Bard Swan: Barbado wants to play a duet with me? Hmmm, I don't know, my beloved seems to actually be attracted to that hairy ape! I am practically broke from buying gifts for Nanarin. Well, if you'll run an errand for me, I'll play a duet with Barbado. What do you say?

links.text: "I will run an errand for you."

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-03.html.text: Bard Swan: Is this too complicated for you? Would you like for me to explain it again? Take the black beer from Jonas' beer chest located in the warehouse and take it to Trader Sabrin . Then go to the grocery store and take Sonia's Event Clothes from the clothes chest and take them to Guard Xaber .

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-06.html.text: Bard Swan: How could you have failed so easy a task? I shall never play a duet with Barbado!

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-04.html.text: Bard Swan: How could you have botched so easy an errand?! Two items should not have been that hard to deliver! Well, at least you delivered one item... I'll play the duet, but I won't give you any money.

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-05.html.text: Bard Swan: Good job! As I promised, I will play a duet . But let him know, I only intend to do this once! Here is your reward for running my errand.

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-07.html.text: Bard Swan: Quiet! I'm writing a letter to my beloved and I must concentrate!

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-02.htm.text: Bard Swan: Oh, thank you so much! Actually, I have already ordered a flute for her from Trader Woodrow of the Town of Aden , a specialist in exotic musical instruments. Please check with him to see if the flute has arrived. Mention my name and he will tell you the status of my order. Afterwards I w…

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-07.html.text: Bard Swan: Oh, I knew it would work! Now, if I can only convince her of my devotion to her... I am greatly indebted to you! Unfortunately, I have spent most of my money on the flute... I've managed to scrape together a bit of money for you. Take it, along with this musical score I composed myself.

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30957-08.html.text: Bard Swan: Oh, I wish I was dead! Perhaps it was the wrong gift. I must have not been trying hard enough. I shall never give up! Somehow I will win the heart of my beloved! Take this as a token of my gratitude for all your help.

Q00364_JovialAccordion/30957-02.html.text: Bard Swan: Please get some black beer from Chef Jonas and take it to Trader Sabrin. Jonas keeps his beer in a beer chest and stores it in a warehouse...
